text: Several visitors reported difficulty finding the library due to incorrect or unclear directions, including issues with the Google Maps pin and signage at nearby visitor centers. The timed ticket system caused frustration, especially when visitors were unaware of the requirement before arrival. Some reviews noted a lack of local North Dakota artists represented in the gift shop and exhibits, with criticism of the use of AI content. Customer service responsiveness was also mentioned as a problem, with at least one visitor unable to get help with ticket changes. Positive comments focused on the building’s architecture, interactive exhibits, and the surrounding landscape.

There is a clear need for better signage and information about timed entry both on-site and beyond the website. Some reviewers expressed disappointment that local North Dakota artists are not well represented in the gift shop and exhibits, and criticized the use of AI-generated content. Positive comments focused on the building’s architecture and views, as well as interactive exhibits, but concerns about navigation and local representation were recurring themes.

windows.60: Visitors have reported ongoing issues with the location and access to the library, including incorrect map pins and difficulty finding the site, which has caused frustration and confusion. Several reviews mention the need for clearer information about the timed ticket system, both onsite and online, as some visitors were turned away unexpectedly. There is criticism regarding the use of AI in exhibits and the lack of representation of local North Dakota artists, as well as dissatisfaction with the gift shop offerings. Customer service responsiveness has also been a concern, with some visitors describing difficulty reaching staff for ticket changes or assistance. Positive comments focus on the architecture, landscape views, and interactive exhibits, but food and beverage quality received some negative remarks.

The requirement for timed tickets was not clearly communicated, leading to some guests being turned away unexpectedly. Some reviews criticized the gift shop for lacking local North Dakota artists and expressed dissatisfaction with the use of AI in exhibits and customer service. While many appreciated the building’s architecture and the surrounding landscape, a few noted problems with food quality and limited staff assistance. Overall, the average rating remains high, but these operational and communication issues should be addressed.
